start_here.title: Distinguish an escape response from a back-taking branch
start_here.task: Locate the running-escape response in Volume 1 and the running-man back-taking heading in Volume 3. Put both in your study notes without assuming they describe the same defensive motion. Course owners can compare the demonstrated starting configurations before linking the lessons.
